run_validation_cli: run the NSVF model validation CLI to evaluate a checkpoint on a validation dataset
run_validate_with_overrides: run validation with model argument overrides on a specific checkpoint path
run_multi_gpu_validation: run distributed validation across all available GPUs for an NSVF model
run_validate_subset: run validation on a specific data subset like val or test split
run_validate_fp16: run validation using FP16 precision to reduce memory usage during evaluation
